Players Committee card image of [[Mon Calamari Dockyards (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. Star Cruisers (except Profundity) may deploy -2 (to a maximum of -3), ignore deployment restrictions in their game text, draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise, and are immune to attrition < 4. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/moncalamaridockyards.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020).
